slides.headline: Rick Ross worked as a Florida correctional officer
slides.body: William Leonard Roberts II had the job before his debut single “Hustlin'” came out in March 2006.

slides.headline: He held the job for 18 months
slides.body: Roberts worked from December 1995 until his resignation in June 1997.

slides.headline: The detail came back up in 2008
slides.body: The Smoking Gun linked Ross to the 18-month stint, and a uniform photo circulated soon after.

slides.headline: Ross later admitted the job was real
slides.body: After the evidence became public, he said he had worked as a correctional officer in Florida from 1995 to 1997.
